findingClass: a completed prospectus-family extraction yields no issuer ratio and names no cause - the reader stopped being called (or never was) and nothing anywhere said so
failThreshold: any COMPLETED RHP/DRHP/PROSPECTUS document whose stored document_fetch_state.extractor_version is at or after the fixed ratio reader (RATIO_FIXED_EXTRACTOR_VERSION = extract_filing.py@2026-09-26b) and whose IPO has no financial_data.current_ratio AND whose E9 step evidence does not carry ratioReasons.current_ratio = ratio_note_not_in_document. ratio_row_not_in_note is a FAIL (reader gap), and quick_ratio's balance_sheet_inputs_absent never excuses a missing current ratio (#771). Documents stored at an older version are PENDING re-read, never FAIL. A FAIL is tracked on #1179. Verdict: scripts/lib/ratio-yield-verdict.mjs
unverifiableWhen: no document in the population has been stored by the fixed reader yet (every one is pending re-read), or no prospectus-family document has completed extraction since the wiring date
why: scraper/scripts/financial_ratios.py merged in #638 with ZERO importers: correct, unit-tested, and never invoked, so every document produced null ratios in silence. A unit test proves the reader reads; only an audit over real rows proves it is still being CALLED. This is the same class as item 8a's peer locator, which was merged into TypeScript where nothing would ever call it. The check deliberately accepts a RECORDED REASON as a pass, because a document with no ratio note in it is a fact about the document, not a defect - what is never acceptable is an absence with no cause (signal-ownership.md R1: a number is not a reading). #771 narrowed the accepted reason: the old any-token match over the whole E9 text would pass every document once E9 carried reasons, because quick_ratio always records balance_sheet_inputs_absent; and ratio_row_not_in_note meant a printed row the reader missed on all four real prospectuses measured (A-One Steels RHP + DRHP, German Green Steel, Green Asia Impex), since the current ratio is a mandatory Schedule III row.
locatorNote: Population: documents extracted on or after the wiring date (RATIO_WIRING_MERGED_AT, default 2026-09-16). Judged: only those whose stored extractor_version is at or after RATIO_FIXED_EXTRACTOR_VERSION - compared by the stored version string, not a date, because staging re-read 9 documents at extract_filing.py@2026-09-26 with the OLD reader (A-One Steels RHP + DRHP null, German Green Steel a stale older-year 1.03). The rest are corrected by the pipeline's own re-read after the version bump, never by a repair. Not checked: the extractor records no ratio_year, so a has-ratio PASS cannot assert the latest printed period; the fixed reader takes the newest column.
